text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's days don't end with<n>training
sessions. She also works a<n>variety of part-time
jobs to earn the<n>money to fund her sisters' dance
classes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Training, classes, and part-time<n>work—she gives
each of them her all.<n>Ines Fujin spares no effort as
she<n>prepares for her debut race, the first<n>step
toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's coworkers, inspired by<n>her incredible
work ethic, lend their<n>encouragement. She's
charming<n>people left, right, and center—myself
included.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If we have less time to train, then I'll<n>just have to
make it up with pure<n>support! As her trainer, I'll do
whatever I can!
